title: EnIGMA: Interactive Tools Substantially Assist LM Agents in Finding Security Vulnerabilities
abstract: We introduce EnIGMA, an LM agent that uses interactive tools to solve Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges. EnIGMA achieves state-of-the-art results on the NYU CTF, InterCode-CTF, and CyBench benchmarks. Our approach enables LM agents to use interactive programs and manage long program outputs effectively.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're a cybersecurity expert trying to solve a puzzle. You need to use various tools to debug, connect to servers, and analyze data. Our key idea is to create an LM agent that can use these interactive tools to solve Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges. We call this agent EnIGMA.

EnIGMA is built on top of SWE-agent, which provides a foundation for LM agents to interact with computer systems. However, SWE-agent lacks the ability to use interactive tools, which are essential for solving CTF challenges.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
EnIGMA uses Interactive Agent Tools (IATs) to enable LM agents to use interactive programs. IATs provide simple and uniform interfaces for the agent to understand. We also introduce summarizers to manage long program outputs.

The agent can use these tools to debug, connect to servers, and analyze data. For example, the agent can use a debugger to analyze a binary file or connect to a server using a remote connection tool.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We evaluate EnIGMA on four benchmarks: NYU CTF, InterCode-CTF, CyBench, and HackTheBox. EnIGMA achieves state-of-the-art results on these benchmarks, surpassing previous systems.

For example, on the NYU CTF benchmark, EnIGMA solves 35% more challenges than the previous best agent.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
EnIGMA's ability to use interactive tools and manage long program outputs makes it a powerful tool for solving CTF challenges. This has significant implications for the field of cybersecurity, where LM agents can be used to automate the process of finding security vulnerabilities.

EnIGMA's success on the benchmarks demonstrates its potential to be used in real-world scenarios, such as penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
EnIGMA's key innovations are its Interactive Agent Tools (IATs) and summarizers. IATs enable LM agents to use interactive programs, while summarizers manage long program outputs.

These innovations make EnIGMA a powerful tool for solving CTF challenges and have significant implications for the field of cybersecurity.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
You can try EnIGMA yourself by using our open-source code and development dataset. We provide guidelines and demonstrations to help you get started.

You can use EnIGMA to solve CTF challenges and explore its potential in real-world scenarios.
